mira: Quick draft of a manager + HR onboarding checklist for next week's hire. Keep it short and measurable. Please add owners.

oliver: Looks good. I'll set Day 1 1:1 and pick a buddy.

mira: Checklist for managers (copy/paste):
```
Pre-start (48h):
- IT: provision laptop + SSO + VPN
- Slack invite + calendar blocks (People Ops)
- Repo access requested (DevEx)
- Manager: schedule week-1 1:1s and team intros

Day 1:
- 9:00 welcome (People Ops) + paperwork
- 10:00 env setup (DevEx/IT)
- 11:00 team intros (short round robin)
- Lunch with buddy
- 14:00 starter task assigned (small PR to run CI)
- EOD: 30m sync with manager (expectations + 30/60/90)

Week 1:
- Cross-team intros: Product, SRE, Security, Support
- Product + metrics overview (30m)
- PR workflow + CI review
- Merge or close starter PR

30/60/90 (examples):
- 30d: ship first small change, 2 PRs merged, complete onboarding checklist
- 60d: own a small area, measurable improvement (perf/coverage)
- 90d: lead demo/rollout, document impact + next goals
```

mira: Owners: People Ops (welcome), IT (hardware/accounts), DevEx (env/repos), Manager (mentor + goals), Security (data access).

it-bot: IT ticket #9912 opened for nina.k  laptop + VPN requested. ETA 2 business days.

nina.k: Quick Q: who approves sandbox/data access for evals?

tara: @nina.k Security needs manager approval + short justification. Use https://internal.redwood.dev/sec/request-access and CC your manager. NDA required for sensitive datasets.

sam: I'll add the onboarding repo and README: git.internal/redwood/onboarding and can run a devcontainer if hardware delayed.

oliver: For 30/60/90 I'll set measurable acceptance criteria in week-1 1:1. Example: 30d = 2 PRs merged + one doc update.

mira: Mentor checklist (short) -> introduce team, review starter task, 1hr/day week 1, quick PR reviews, lunch intro. I'll DM the template to assigned buddy.

nina.k: Thanks all! Appreciate the checklist. Looking forward to Day 1. :wave:

mira: Closing loop  I'll update the master template with these specifics and send final invites once IT confirms provisioning. :white_check_mark:
